doc_access_2007.title: Internet Governance Forum Rio de Janeiro, Brazil 13 November 2007 Access
doc_access_2007.summary: Opening of the IGF 2007 Access main session in Rio de Janeiro: Markus Kummer introduces the session and Brazilian communications minister Helio Costa makes introductory remarks on access, infrastructure costs and the digital divide.

doc_closing_2006.title: Internet Governance Forum 2 November 2006 Closing Ceremony
doc_closing_2006.summary: Closing ceremony of the inaugural IGF in Athens: Minister Liapis welcomes participants and thanks them, then special advisor to the UN Secretary-General Nitin Desai reviews the four days and thanks the organizing team.

doc_consult_2007.title: 13 February 2007 IGF Consultations Geneva - Taking stock and the way forward
doc_consult_2007.summary: Open consultation in Geneva on taking stock of the Athens IGF and the way forward: Chairman Desai explains the purpose of the meeting, to assess the lessons from Athens and report them to the Secretary-General.
